links.outcome: Accuracy and abstention rate when model defers uncertain cases
links.effect: Abstention mechanism raised accuracy from 80.8% to 95.5% with a 34.2% (n=12) abstention rate; 10/12 abstained cases were NOTACP.
links.quote: Specifically, we observed an accuracy of 95.5%, sensitivity of 0.933, specificity of 0.833, FNR of 0.067, and FPR of 0.125.

links.outcome: Whether calibrated predictive uncertainty (variance) identifies uncertain predictions
links.effect: Mean predictive values were uninformative, but predictive variance separated classes; combining ArgMax and variance-based predictions gave 95.5% accuracy versus 68.6% for ArgMax alone.
links.quote: Therefore, the variance of the predictive distributions is informative in our classification task.
